messages.subject: RE: Project Mallory — A&R agreement, first draft (Sterling mark-up)
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Sterling's comments are in the attached redline. The principal commercial changes: margin uplift to 200bps (4.50%) rather than 175bps; amendment fee to 1.00% (£420,000); and the March 2026 net leverage covenant tightened to 5.00x. The bank views these as the price of the new money and the covenant relief. Other comments are minor/legal.

Happy to discuss — I expect Richard will want to push back on pricing.

Rebecca Lang
Associate | Drummond Hale LLP
